crossRefs.note: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu…
“Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister…
Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered…
These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Aaron, high priest after his father

people.name: Ithamar
people.line: Youngest son of Aaron; served as priest.

people.name: Nadab
people.line: Son of Aaron, consumed by fire for offering incense.

translations.web: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translations.bsb: These were the divisions of the descendants of Aaron. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translations.kjv: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translations.asv: And the courses of the sons of Aaron were these. The sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
